program_text = '''def transform(grid):
    """Fill every cell blank in both 4x4 halves with color 4."""
    width = len(grid[0])
    split = width // 2
    return [
        [4 if row[c] == 0 and row[c + split] == 0 else 0 for c in range(split)]
        for row in grid
    ]
'''
